name: Alene
title: Circle of the Stars Druid
role: The party's spell save DC caster and only healer: control spells under a Starry Form, radiant debuffs on the side.

entries.note: +2 WIS for 20, if you got the one-time +1 WIS boost found in Act 1
+1 WIS and +1 CON for WIS 18, without that boost
if WIS is already 20; Advantage on concentration saves
+2 WIS for 20, if you didn't get the Act 1 boost
go first and can't be surprised
if you didn't take it at level 8

gear.note: +1 spell DC and spell attack; Melf's Acid Arrow once a day.
Clothing: +1 spell DC. Its +1 AC and saves need Lightning Charges, which nothing on this page gives you.
You regain 1d6 HP whenever you heal someone else. A reward from Zevlor for helping the refugees.
When you succeed on a saving throw, the enemy that forced it takes 1d4 psychic damage. Late Act 1, in the Crèche.
Medium armour: your radiant damage sets off a shockwave that adds Radiating Orb.
Radiant, thunder and lightning damage add Reverberation (−1 to STR, DEX and CON saves per turn).
Inflicting a condition also adds Reverberation.
Light armour with Advantage on CON saves.
8 temporary HP whenever you cast a concentration spell.
+1 AC and saves.
Your heals give resistance to weapon damage for 2 turns.
Your heals give +1d4 to attacks and saves for 2 turns.
+1 cold damage and Chilled on cold spells: for an Ice Knife and Ice Storm habit.
Clothing: +1 spell DC.
+1 spell DC and +1 initiative.
+1 spell DC while you're Threatened.
+1 spell DC and spell attack, Advantage on DEX saves.
Healing Word and Mass Healing Word once per long rest each, without spending your slots. Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark.
Ray of Fear and Wounding Ray as 3rd-level spells, once per long rest each. Worn by the Spectator at the Underdark's Petrified Battlefield.
Restore one spell slot of any level, once per long rest.
Your radiant damage adds 2 turns of Radiating Orb (−1 to the target's attack rolls per turn).
Spell damage while you're lit adds Radiating Orb. Produce Flame keeps you lit.
+1 AC and saves. Pass it to Zetharis once you have Cloak of the Weave.
+2 spell DC and spell attack.
+2 spell DC. Looting it from the offering chest curses you: falling unconscious kills you until it's removed, so cast Greater Restoration on yourself right away.
+1 spell DC and spell attack, and your next spell is free once a day.
+1 spell DC and spell attack; you heal 1d4 when enemies fail your saves. It's destroyed if you leave the spawn behind after the fight with Cazador.
Light armour: +1 spell DC, Advantage on CON saves to hold concentration, Plant Growth each short rest, and 1d4 HP each turn you start in it.
While concentrating, add your WIS modifier to every save and +1 AC. Needs a Persuasion check to open Ferg Drogher's special stock.
+1 spell DC and spell attack.
+1 spell DC; Command once a day.
+1 spell DC for any caster.
One more Wild Shape charge: one more Starry Form a day.
Ranged slot: +3 initiative. Druids aren't proficient with longbows, so its chance of Faerie Fire on a hit is a bonus, not a plan.
Starry Form counts as Wild Shape: 22 temporary HP each time you take it, +2 AC and Advantage on saves against spells. Swapping constellations drops the temporary HP.
+1 spell DC and spell attack. Its Absorb Elements is bugged (per the wiki).

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Good picks per slot. Mix to taste: Spell DC, Radiant debuffs, or Concentration to hold your spells.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: The radiant debuff kit comes together here, alongside the first +1 DC pieces.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: The spell DC capstones arrive. Stacking the DC pieces reaches about DC 27, if the +1 DC pieces stack: check the number in game.
